$comment: Care at home after common dental treatments, in plain English, shown on the patient's visit page and (top three steps) in the doctor's WhatsApp summary. Keys are stable and lower_snake_case; each entry has 3 to 6 steps, most important first, and a 'call us if' line. Clinics cannot edit this in v1. Hindi and Marathi follow after review by a native-speaking dentist.

extraction.title: After a tooth removal
steps: Keep biting on the gauze pad for 30 to 45 minutes, then throw it away.
For 24 hours, don't spit, rinse hard, use a straw or smoke.
Eat soft, cool food today and chew on the other side.
From tomorrow, rinse gently with warm salt water after meals.
Take your medicines as prescribed and rest today.
extraction.call_if: Call us if bleeding doesn't stop after an hour of firm pressure, or if pain or swelling gets worse after the third day.

wisdom_extraction.title: After wisdom tooth removal
steps: Keep biting on the gauze pad for 45 minutes; replace it if bleeding continues.
Hold an ice pack on your cheek for 10 minutes on, 10 minutes off, today.
For 24 hours, don't spit, rinse hard, use a straw or smoke.
Eat soft, cool food for 2 to 3 days and chew on the other side.
From tomorrow, rinse gently with warm salt water after meals.
Some swelling and stiff jaw for 3 to 4 days is normal; sleep with your head raised.
wisdom_extraction.call_if: Call us if you have fever, bleeding that doesn't stop, a bad taste with rising pain after day three, or numbness that lasts beyond tomorrow.

root_canal.title: After root canal treatment
steps: Don't eat until the numbness wears off, so you don't bite your cheek or tongue.
Avoid chewing hard food on this tooth until it has its crown.
Mild soreness for 2 to 3 days is normal; take your medicines as prescribed.
Get the crown done as planned; a root-treated tooth can crack without one.
Brush and floss as usual.
root_canal.call_if: Call us if you have swelling, severe pain that keeps getting worse, or your bite feels high.

root_canal_between_sittings.title: Between root canal sittings
steps: The tooth has a temporary filling; don't chew hard or sticky food on it.
Don't eat for an hour, and until the numbness wears off.
Some tenderness is normal; take your medicines as prescribed.
Come for your next sitting on time so the tooth doesn't get reinfected.
Brush gently around the tooth as usual.
root_canal_between_sittings.call_if: Call us if the temporary filling falls out, or you have swelling or severe pain.

filling.title: After a filling
steps: Wait until the numbness wears off before eating or drinking hot things.
Some sensitivity to cold for a few days is normal.
Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste and floss daily.
Cut down on sweets and sticky snacks between meals.
filling.call_if: Call us if your bite feels high, or pain or sensitivity lasts beyond a week.

crown.title: After a crown or cap
steps: If you have a temporary crown, avoid sticky and hard food on that side.
Slide floss out sideways instead of pulling it up around the crown.
Some sensitivity for a few days is normal.
Don't bite on very hard things like ice, bones or nut shells.
Brush and floss around the crown every day.
crown.call_if: Call us if the crown feels loose or high, comes off, or the tooth hurts when you bite.

implant.title: After an implant
steps: Hold an ice pack on your cheek for 10 minutes on, 10 minutes off, today.
Eat soft food and chew on the other side until we tell you otherwise.
Don't smoke; it is the main reason implants fail.
From tomorrow, rinse gently with warm salt water or the prescribed mouthwash.
Take your medicines as prescribed and keep every review visit.
implant.call_if: Call us if bleeding doesn't stop, swelling grows after the third day, you have fever, or the implant feels loose.

scaling.title: After cleaning (scaling)
steps: Some gum bleeding and sensitivity for a few days is normal.
Rinse with warm salt water twice a day for 3 days.
Brush twice a day with a soft brush and floss daily.
Avoid very hot, cold or spicy food for a day or two.
Get a cleaning every 6 months.
scaling.call_if: Call us if gums keep bleeding after a week or you notice swelling.

whitening.title: After teeth whitening
steps: For 48 hours, avoid tea, coffee, cola, red sauces and turmeric-rich food.
Don't smoke or chew tobacco or paan.
Use a toothpaste for sensitive teeth if they feel sensitive.
Brush twice a day to keep the result longer.
whitening.call_if: Call us if sensitivity is severe or lasts more than 3 days.
